(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) SENSOR VOTING & HEALTH DIAGNOSTICS                            *)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* --- 2.1 Airlock Chamber Static Pressure 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bAirlock_A_Valid := (rAirlockPressure_A >= 0.1) AND (rAirlockPressure_A <= 125000.0);
bAirlock_B_Valid := (rAirlockPressure_B >= 0.1) AND (rAirlockPressure_B <= 125000.0);
bAirlock_C_Valid := (rAirlockPressure_C >= 0.1) AND (rAirlockPressure_C <= 125000.0);

IF bAirlock_A_Valid AND bAirlock_B_Valid AND bAirlock_C_Valid THEN
    (* All 3 channels within physical limits: compute median *)
    IF (rAirlockPressure_A >= rAirlockPressure_B AND rAirlockPressure_A <= rAirlockPressure_C) OR
       (rAirlockPressure_A >= rAirlockPressure_C AND rAirlockPressure_A <= rAirlockPressure_B) THEN
        rVotedAirlockPress_Internal := rAirlockPressure_A;
    ELSIF (rAirlockPressure_B >= rAirlockPressure_A AND rAirlockPressure_B <= rAirlockPressure_C) OR
          (rAirlockPressure_B >= rAirlockPressure_C AND rAirlockPressure_B <= rAirlockPressure_A) THEN
        rVotedAirlockPress_Internal := rAirlockPressure_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedAirlockPress_Internal := rAirlockPressure_C;
    END_IF;
    bAirlock_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;

    (* Check for sensor calibration drift between healthy channels *)
    IF (ABS(rAirlockPressure_A - rAirlockPressure_B) > c_rAirlockPressDevLimit) OR
       (ABS(rAirlockPressure_B - rAirlockPressure_C) > c_rAirlockPressDevLimit) OR
       (ABS(rAirlockPressure_C - rAirlockPressure_A) > c_rAirlockPressDevLimit) THEN
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Airlock Pressure Sensor Drift Warning *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bAirlock_A_Valid AND bAirlock_B_Valid THEN
    rVotedAirlockPress_Internal := (rAirlockPressure_A + rAirlockPressure_B) * 0.5;
    bAirlock_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Channel C Airlock Pressure Fault *)
ELSIF bAirlock_B_Valid AND bAirlock_C_Valid THEN
    rVotedAirlockPress_Internal := (rAirlockPressure_B + rAirlockPressure_C) * 0.5;
    bAirlock_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Channel A Airlock Pressure Fault *)
ELSIF bAirlock_A_Valid AND bAirlock_C_Valid THEN
    rVotedAirlockPress_Internal := (rAirlockPressure_A + rAirlockPressure_C) * 0.5;
    bAirlock_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Channel B Airlock Pressure Fault *)
ELSE
    (* Multiple sensor failure: Catastrophic loss of chamber pressure telemetry *)
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Critical Airlock Pressure TMR Breakdown *)

rVotedAirlockPressure := rVotedAirlockPress_Internal;

(* --- 2.2 Guideway Tube Static Pressure 2oo3 Voting --- *)

    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0020;
ELSIF bTube_B_Valid AND bTube_C_Valid THEN

(* --- 2.3 Seal Pneumatic Inflation Pressure 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bSealP_A_Valid := (rSealInflationPressure_A >= -0.5) AND (rSealInflationPressure_A <= 12.0);
bSealP_B_Valid := (rSealInflationPressure_B >= -0.5) AND (rSealInflationPressure_B <= 12.0);
bSealP_C_Valid := (rSealInflationPressure_C >= -0.5) AND (rSealInflationPressure_C <= 12.0);

IF bSealP_A_Valid AND bSealP_B_Valid AND bSealP_C_Valid THEN

ELSIF bSealP_B_Valid AND bSealP_C_Valid THEN
    rVotedSealPress_Internal := (rSealInflationPressure_B + rSealInflationPressure_C) * 0.5;
    bSealP_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0400;
ELSIF bSealP_A_Valid AND bSealP_C_Valid THEN
    rVotedSealPress_Internal := (rSealInflationPressure_A + rSealInflationPressure_C) * 0.5;
    bSealP_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0800;

(* --- 2.4 Seal Flange Gap Displacement 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bSealG_A_Valid := (rSealCompressionGap_A >= 0.0) AND (rSealCompressionGap_A <= 40.0);

    ELSIF (rSealCompressionGap_B >= rSealCompressionGap_A AND rSealCompressionGap_B <= rSealCompressionGap_C) OR

ELSIF bSealG_B_Valid AND bSealG_C_Valid THEN

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 3.0 NON-LINEAR VISCOELASTIC INFLATABLE ELASTOMER SEAL CONTACT MECHANICS                           *)
(* Mooney-Rivlin hyperelastic stress formulation, dynamic anti-blowout margin, and leak estimation.   *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Compute Seal Uniaxial Stretch Ratio lambda = 1.0 - (delta_gap / h_nominal) *)
IF c_rSealWidth > 0.001 THEN
    rSealNominalCompressionRatio := 1.0 - ((25.0 - rVotedSealGap_Internal) / (c_rSealWidth * 1000.0));
ELSE
    rSealNominalCompressionRatio := 1.0;
END_IF;
IF rSealNominalCompressionRatio < 0.65 THEN
    rSealNominalCompressionRatio := 0.65; (* Maximum structural strain boundary *)
ELSIF rSealNominalCompressionRatio > 1.05 THEN
    rSealNominalCompressionRatio := 1.05;
END_IF;

(* Mooney-Rivlin Hyperelastic Contact Stress: sigma = 2*C10*(lambda - lambda^-2) + 2*C01*(1 - lambda^-3) *)
rTempA := rSealNominalCompressionRatio;
IF rTempA > 0.1 THEN
    rTempB := (rTempA - (1.0 / (rTempA * rTempA)));
    rTempC := (1.0 - (1.0 / (rTempA * rTempA * rTempA)));
    (* Net Contact Stress in MPa = Hyperelastic Base Stress + Pneumatic Actuation Pressure (bar/10) *)
    rSealContactStressMpa := (2.0 * c_rSealMooneyRivlin_C10 * rTempB) +
                             (2.0 * c_rSealMooneyRivlin_C01 * rTempC) +
                             (rVotedSealPress_Internal * 0.10);
ELSE
    rSealContactStressMpa := 0.0;
END_IF;
IF rSealContactStressMpa < 0.0 THEN
    rSealContactStressMpa := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Viscoelastic Maxwell Relaxation Creep: d(sigma_creep)/dt = E_visco * d_eps/dt - sigma_creep / tau *)
rSealViscoelasticCreep := rSealViscoelasticCreep * 0.9985 + (rSealContactStressMpa * 0.0015);

(* Differential Pressure Anti-Blowout Margin: Ratio of Seal Friction Restoring Force to Pressure Force *)
(* F_friction = mu * sigma_contact * A_contact; F_pressure = Delta_P * A_transverse *)
rChamberDifferentialForce := ABS(rVotedAirlockPress_Internal - rVotedTubePress_Internal) * c_rAirlockInternalArea;
rSealStaticFrictionForce := (rSealContactStressMpa * 1000000.0) * (c_rSealCircumferenceLength * c_rSealWidth) * c_rSealFrictionCoefficient;

IF rChamberDifferentialForce > 100.0 THEN
    rSealBlowoutSafetyMargin := rSealStaticFrictionForce / rChamberDifferentialForce;
ELSE
    rSealBlowoutSafetyMargin := 99.9; (* Infinitely safe when differential pressure is negligible *)
END_IF;

IF (rSealBlowoutSafetyMargin < 1.35) AND (iState >= 30) AND (iState <= 75) THEN
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Critical Seal Blowout Hazard Alarm *)
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 4.0 RAREFIED GAS DYNAMICS & MULTI-STAGE VACUUM PUMPING CASCADE REGIME MODEL                       *)
(* Calculates mean free path, Knudsen number, flow regime, effective pumping speeds, and leak-back.  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Gas Mean Free Path lambda = (k_B * T) / (sqrt(2) * pi * sigma^2 * P) *)
rTempA := 1.41421356 * 3.14159265 * (c_rEffectiveMoleculeDiam * c_rEffectiveMoleculeDiam) * rVotedAirlockPress_Internal;
IF rTempA > 1.0E-25 THEN
    rMeanFreePathLambda := (c_rBoltzmannConstant * rChamberGasTemperature) / rTempA;
ELSE
    rMeanFreePathLambda := 1.0;
END_IF;

(* Dimensionless Knudsen Number Kn = lambda / D_hydraulic *)
IF c_rAirlockHydraulicDiameter > 0.01 THEN
    rKnudsenNumber := rMeanFreePathLambda / c_rAirlockHydraulicDiameter;
ELSE
    rKnudsenNumber := 0.001;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Gas Viscosity via Sutherland Law for Dry Air: mu(T) = mu0 * (T/T0)^(3/2) * (T0 + S)/(T + S) *)
rTempB := rChamberGasTemperature / 291.15;
rDynamicAirViscosity := 0.00001827 * (rTempB * SQRT(rTempB)) * ((291.15 + 120.0) / (rChamberGasTemperature + 120.0));

(* Mean Maxwellian Molecular Thermal Velocity: v_th = sqrt(8 * R_spec * T / pi) *)
rMolecularThermalSpeed := SQRT((8.0 * c_rSpecificGasConstantAir * rChamberGasTemperature) / 3.14159265);

(* Multi-Stage Pumping Cascade Dispatch & Pumping Speed Characteristic *)
(* Stage 1: Roots Vacuum Blower Effective Speed S_roots = S0 * (1 - 1 / K_compression) *)
IF rRootsBlowerSpeedFeedback > 100.0 THEN
    rRootsCompressionRatio := 1.0 + (12.5 * (rRootsBlowerSpeedFeedback / c_rRootsMaxNominalSpeed) *
                                   (1.0 / (1.0 + (rVotedAirlockPress_Internal / 2000.0))));
    IF rRootsCompressionRatio > 1.05 THEN
        rRootsEffectiveSpeed := c_rRootsMaxDisplacement * (rRootsBlowerSpeedFeedback / c_rRootsMaxNominalSpeed) *
                                (1.0 - (1.0 / rRootsCompressionRatio));
    ELSE
        rRootsEffectiveSpeed := 0.1;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rRootsEffectiveSpeed := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Stage 2: Mag-Lev Turbomolecular Pump Speed S_tmp(Kn, omega) in Molecular / Transitional Flow *)
IF (rTurbomolecularSpeedFeedback > 5000.0) AND (rVotedAirlockPress_Internal < c_rForelineMaxSafePressure) THEN
    (* Molecular pumping efficiency increases as Knudsen number exceeds transitional threshold (Kn > 0.01) *)
    IF rKnudsenNumber >= 0.10 THEN
        rTempC := 1.0; (* Full molecular pumping capability *)
    ELSIF rKnudsenNumber <= 0.005 THEN
        rTempC := 0.08; (* Severe aerodynamic stalling & gas friction *)
    ELSE
        rTempC := 0.08 + (0.92 * ((rKnudsenNumber - 0.005) / 0.095));
    END_IF;
    rTMPEffectiveSpeed := c_rTMPRatedPumpingSpeed * (rTurbomolecularSpeedFeedback / c_rTMPRatedSpeed) * rTempC;
ELSE
    rTMPEffectiveSpeed := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Combined Pumping Speed *)
rTotalPumpingSpeed := rRootsEffectiveSpeed + rTMPEffectiveSpeed;

(* Stainless Steel Outgassing Load Decay: Q_outgas(t) = q0 * A_surface / (1 + t/t0)^alpha *)
rTempD := 1.0 + (rEvacuationTimeElapsed / 18.0);
IF rTempD > 0.1 THEN
    rOutgassingRatePerArea := 0.00018 / SQRT(rTempD); (* Alpha ~ 0.5 initial surface water desorption *)
ELSE
    rOutgassingRatePerArea := 0.00018;
END_IF;
rIntegratedOutgassingLoad := rOutgassingRatePerArea * c_rChamberWettedSurfaceArea;

(* Real-Time Chamber Differential Rate of Pressure Change dP/dt [Pa/s] *)
rCalculatedRateOfPressChange := (rVotedAirlockPress_Internal - rPreviousAirlockPressure) / c_rScanTimeSeconds;
rPreviousAirlockPressure := rVotedAirlockPress_Internal;

(* Net Specific Airlock Leak Rate Q_leak = V * dP/dt + S*P - Q_outgas *)
IF (iState = 25) OR ((rTotalPumpingSpeed < 0.05) AND (rVotedAirlockPress_Internal < 50000.0)) THEN
    (* Isolated leak-rate evaluation *)
    rEstimatedLeakBackLoad := (c_rAirlockInternalVolume * rCalculatedRateOfPressChange) - rIntegratedOutgassingLoad;
    IF rEstimatedLeakBackLoad < 0.0 THEN
        rEstimatedLeakBackLoad := 0.0;
    END_IF;
    rCalculatedLeakRate := rEstimatedLeakBackLoad;
END_IF;

(* Model-Based Prediction of Remaining Evacuation Time to Crossover [s] *)
IF (rVotedAirlockPress_Internal > c_rRootsCrossoverPressure) AND (rTotalPumpingSpeed > 0.5) THEN
    rEstimatedEvacuationTimeRemaining := (c_rAirlockInternalVolume / rTotalPumpingSpeed) *
                                         LN(rVotedAirlockPress_Internal / c_rRootsCrossoverPressure);
ELSIF (rVotedAirlockPress_Internal <= c_rRootsCrossoverPressure) AND (rTMPEffectiveSpeed > 2.0) THEN
    rEstimatedEvacuationTimeRemaining := (c_rAirlockInternalVolume / rTMPEffectiveSpeed) *
                                         LN(rVotedAirlockPress_Internal / c_rTargetChamberPressure);
ELSE
    rEstimatedEvacuationTimeRemaining := 0.0;
END_IF;
IF rEstimatedEvacuationTimeRemaining < 0.0 THEN
    rEstimatedEvacuationTimeRemaining := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 5.0 RESIDUAL SHOCK WAVE REFLECTION SUPPRESSION & RANKINE-HUGONIOT DAMPING                         *)
(* Computes normal shock jump across opening boundary and tunes acoustic Helmholtz impedance.       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Pressure Ratio P_airlock / P_tube across isolating knife gate *)
IF rVotedTubePress_Internal > 0.5 THEN
    rChamberTubePressureRatio := rVotedAirlockPress_Internal / rVotedTubePress_Internal;
ELSE
    rChamberTubePressureRatio := 1.0;
END_IF;

(* Rankine-Hugoniot Incident Shock Mach Number: Ms = sqrt( ((gamma+1)/(2*gamma))*(P_ratio - 1) + 1 ) *)
IF rChamberTubePressureRatio > 1.005 THEN
    rTempA := ((c_rSpecificHeatRatioGamma + 1.0) / (2.0 * c_rSpecificHeatRatioGamma)) *
              (rChamberTubePressureRatio - 1.0) + 1.0;
    IF rTempA > 1.0 THEN
        rShockMachNumber := SQRT(rTempA);
    ELSE
        rShockMachNumber := 1.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rShockMachNumber := 1.0;
END_IF;

(* Rankine-Hugoniot Incident Static Overpressure Jump Delta P = P_tube * (2*gamma/(gamma+1))*(Ms^2 - 1) *)
rShockOverpressureJump := rVotedTubePress_Internal *
                          ((2.0 * c_rSpecificHeatRatioGamma) / (c_rSpecificHeatRatioGamma + 1.0)) *
                          ((rShockMachNumber * rShockMachNumber) - 1.0);
rPredictedShockOverpressure := rShockOverpressureJump;

(* Predicted Acoustic Sound Pressure Level SPL = 20 * log10(Delta P_rms / 20 uPa) *)
IF rShockOverpressureJump > 0.01 THEN
    rTempB := (rShockOverpressureJump * 0.70710678) / 0.000020;
    IF rTempB > 1.0 THEN
        rPredictedIncidentSPL := 20.0 * (LN(rTempB) / 2.30258509);
    ELSE
        rPredictedIncidentSPL := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rPredictedIncidentSPL := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Acoustic Wave Reflection Damper Helmholtz Tuning: f_res = (c / 2*pi) * sqrt( A_neck / (V_cavity * L_eff) ) *)
(* Speed of sound c = sqrt(gamma * R_spec * T) *)
rShockWavePropagationSpeed := SQRT(c_rSpecificHeatRatioGamma * c_rSpecificGasConstantAir * rChamberGasTemperature);

(* Variable Baffle Linear Stroke Position [0 to 450 mm] to match Quarter-Wave Standing Modes *)
IF rShockWavePropagationSpeed > 50.0 AND c_rAirlockInternalLength > 1.0 THEN
    (* Fundamental acoustic tube quarter-wave resonance mode f1 = c / (4 * L) *)
    rHelmholtzResonantFreq := rShockWavePropagationSpeed / (4.0 * c_rAirlockInternalLength);
    (* Dynamic Baffle Actuator Stroke modulation proportional to acoustic SPL error *)
    rTempC := (rPredictedIncidentSPL - 65.0) / (c_rShockMaxAllowableSPL - 65.0);
    IF rTempC < 0.0 THEN rTempC := 0.0; ELSIF rTempC > 1.0 THEN rTempC := 1.0; END_IF;
    rAcousticBaffleLinearStroke := rTempC * c_rBaffleStrokeMax;
ELSE
    rAcousticBaffleLinearStroke := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Micro-Bleed Equalization Choked Flow Limiter: m_dot_choked = A_throat * P_up * sqrt(gamma/RT) * (2/(gamma+1))^((gamma+1)/(2*(gamma-1))) *)
IF rVotedAirlockPress_Internal > (rVotedTubePress_Internal * 1.8929) THEN
    (* Choked sonic flow regime through equalization bypass orifice *)
    rTempD := SQRT(c_rSpecificHeatRatioGamma / (c_rSpecificGasConstantAir * rChamberGasTemperature)) * 0.5787;
    rChokedMassFlowMax := 0.0125 * rVotedAirlockPress_Internal * rTempD; (* A_orifice = 0.0125 m2 *)
ELSE
    (* Subsonic pressure equalization *)
    rChokedMassFlowMax := 0.0125 * SQRT(2.0 * rVotedAirlockPress_Internal *
                                        (rVotedAirlockPress_Internal - rVotedTubePress_Internal) /
                                        (c_rSpecificGasConstantAir * rChamberGasTemperature));
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 6.0 COMPLETE STATE-SPACE MODEL & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) OPTIMIZATION                      *)
(* Evaluates discrete-time dynamic state vector, cost function gradients, and actuator increments.   *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Compute Deviation States relative to Linearization Trajectory Target *)
x1_PressDev     := rVotedAirlockPress_Internal - rTargetChamberPressure;
x2_ForelineDev  := (rVotedAirlockPress_Internal * 0.12) - (c_rRootsCrossoverPressure * 0.5);
x3_SealPressDev := rVotedSealPress_Internal - rTargetSealPressure;
x4_TMPSpeedDev  := rTurbomolecularSpeedFeedback - rTargetTMPSpeed;
x5_ShockAmpDev  := rShockOverpressureJump - rTargetShockAmplitude;
x6_ShockRateDev := rCalculatedRateOfPressChange;

(* 1-Step Ahead State Space Prediction: x_next = Ad * x + Bd * u *)
x1_Next := (Ad_11 * x1_PressDev) + (Ad_12 * x2_ForelineDev) + (Ad_13 * x3_SealPressDev) +
           (Ad_14 * x4_TMPSpeedDev) + (Ad_15 * x5_ShockAmpDev) + (Ad_16 * x6_ShockRateDev) +
           (Bd_11 * rOpt_Delta_RootsSpeed) + (Bd_12 * rOpt_Delta_EqualValve);

x2_Next := (Ad_21 * x1_PressDev) + (Ad_22 * x2_ForelineDev) + (Ad_23 * x3_SealPressDev) +
           (Ad_24 * x4_TMPSpeedDev) + (Ad_25 * x5_ShockAmpDev) + (Ad_26 * x6_ShockRateDev) +
           (Bd_21 * rOpt_Delta_RootsSpeed) + (Bd_22 * rOpt_Delta_EqualValve);

x3_Next := (Ad_31 * x1_PressDev) + (Ad_32 * x2_ForelineDev) + (Ad_33 * x3_SealPressDev) +
           (Ad_34 * x4_TMPSpeedDev) + (Ad_35 * x5_ShockAmpDev) + (Ad_36 * x6_ShockRateDev) +
           (Bd_33 * rOpt_Delta_SealPress);

x4_Next := (Ad_41 * x1_PressDev) + (Ad_42 * x2_ForelineDev) + (Ad_43 * x3_SealPressDev) +
           (Ad_44 * x4_TMPSpeedDev) + (Ad_45 * x5_ShockAmpDev) + (Ad_46 * x6_ShockRateDev);

x5_Next := (Ad_51 * x1_PressDev) + (Ad_52 * x2_ForelineDev) + (Ad_53 * x3_SealPressDev) +
           (Ad_54 * x4_TMPSpeedDev) + (Ad_55 * x5_ShockAmpDev) + (Ad_56 * x6_ShockRateDev) +
           (Bd_52 * rOpt_Delta_EqualValve) + (Bd_54 * rOpt_Delta_BaffleStroke);

x6_Next := (Ad_61 * x1_PressDev) + (Ad_62 * x2_ForelineDev) + (Ad_63 * x3_SealPressDev) +
           (Ad_64 * x4_TMPSpeedDev) + (Ad_65 * x5_ShockAmpDev) + (Ad_66 * x6_ShockRateDev) +
           (Bd_62 * rOpt_Delta_EqualValve) + (Bd_64 * rOpt_Delta_BaffleStroke);

(* Analytical Quadratic Cost Minimization: J = x^T * Q * x + u^T * R * u *)
(* Gradient evaluation: grad_u(J) = Bd^T * Q * (Ad * x) + R * u *)
rGrad1 := (Bd_11 * rMPC_Weight_PressureTrack * (Ad_11 * x1_PressDev + Ad_12 * x2_ForelineDev)) +
          (rMPC_Weight_dRootsSpeed * rOpt_Delta_RootsSpeed);

rGrad2 := (Bd_12 * rMPC_Weight_PressureTrack * (Ad_11 * x1_PressDev + Ad_12 * x2_ForelineDev)) +
          (Bd_52 * rMPC_Weight_ShockSuppression * (Ad_55 * x5_ShockAmpDev + Ad_56 * x6_ShockRateDev)) +
          (rMPC_Weight_dValvePos * rOpt_Delta_EqualValve);

rGrad3 := (Bd_33 * rMPC_Weight_SealIntegrity * (Ad_33 * x3_SealPressDev)) +
          (rMPC_Weight_dSealRegulator * rOpt_Delta_SealPress);

rGrad4 := (Bd_54 * rMPC_Weight_ShockSuppression * (Ad_55 * x5_ShockAmpDev + Ad_56 * x6_ShockRateDev)) +
          (rMPC_Weight_dBaffleStroke * rOpt_Delta_BaffleStroke);

(* Diagonal Hessian Approximation: Hess_ii = Bd_i^T * Q * Bd_i + R_ii *)
rHess1 := (Bd_11 * Bd_11 * rMPC_Weight_PressureTrack) + rMPC_Weight_dRootsSpeed;
rHess2 := (Bd_12 * Bd_12 * rMPC_Weight_PressureTrack) + (Bd_52 * Bd_52 * rMPC_Weight_ShockSuppression) + rMPC_Weight_dValvePos;
rHess3 := (Bd_33 * Bd_33 * rMPC_Weight_SealIntegrity) + rMPC_Weight_dSealRegulator;
rHess4 := (Bd_54 * Bd_54 * rMPC_Weight_ShockSuppression) + rMPC_Weight_dBaffleStroke;

(* Newton-Raphson Gradient Descent Step with Actuator Saturation & Slew Limiting *)
IF rHess1 > 0.001 THEN rOpt_Delta_RootsSpeed  := rOpt_Delta_RootsSpeed  - (0.65 * rGrad1 / rHess1); END_IF;
IF rHess2 > 0.001 THEN rOpt_Delta_EqualValve  := rOpt_Delta_EqualValve  - (0.65 * rGrad2 / rHess2); END_IF;
IF rHess3 > 0.001 THEN rOpt_Delta_SealPress   := rOpt_Delta_SealPress   - (0.65 * rGrad3 / rHess3); END_IF;
IF rHess4 > 0.001 THEN rOpt_Delta_BaffleStroke := rOpt_Delta_BaffleStroke - (0.65 * rGrad4 / rHess4); END_IF;

(* Actuator Slew Rate Clamping *)
IF rOpt_Delta_RootsSpeed > 150.0 THEN rOpt_Delta_RootsSpeed := 150.0; ELSIF rOpt_Delta_RootsSpeed < -150.0 THEN rOpt_Delta_RootsSpeed := -150.0; END_IF;
IF rOpt_Delta_EqualValve > 5.0 THEN rOpt_Delta_EqualValve := 5.0; ELSIF rOpt_Delta_EqualValve < -5.0 THEN rOpt_Delta_EqualValve := -5.0; END_IF;
IF rOpt_Delta_SealPress > 0.15 THEN rOpt_Delta_SealPress := 0.15; ELSIF rOpt_Delta_SealPress < -0.15 THEN rOpt_Delta_SealPress := -0.15; END_IF;
IF rOpt_Delta_BaffleStroke > 12.0 THEN rOpt_Delta_BaffleStroke := 12.0; ELSIF rOpt_Delta_BaffleStroke < -12.0 THEN rOpt_Delta_BaffleStroke := -12.0; END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 7.0 MULTI-STAGE SUPERVISORY FINITE STATE MACHINE (CASE iState OF ... END_CASE;)                   *)
(* Deterministic sequence orchestration from Atmospheric Standby through Deep Vacuum to Pod Transit. *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
CASE iState OF
    0: (* STATE 0: STANDBY_ATMOSPHERIC - Station Ingress/Egress Door Open, Seals Deflated *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bSealsInflatedAndLocked := FALSE;
        bChamberEvacuatedToTarget := FALSE;
        bTubeGateValveOpenDemand := FALSE;
        bAcousticShockSuppressed := FALSE;
        rRootsBlowerSpeedDemand := 0.0;
        rTurbomolecularSpeedDemand := 0.0;
        rSealPressureSetpoint := 0.0;
        rEqualizationValveDemand := 0.0;
        rAcousticBaffleLinearStroke := 0.0;
        rEvacuationTimeElapsed := 0.0;
        rStateTimerAccumulator := 0.0;

        (* Transition to Stage 10 upon Operator Request and Docking Latch Confirmation *)
        IF bMasterEnableCycle AND bPodDockingLatched AND bStationGateClosedInterlock THEN
            bSystemReady := FALSE;
            bSystemRunning := TRUE;
            iState := 10;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE 10: STATION_ISOLATION_VERIFICATION - Verify Barrier Closure & Pre-Seat Clearance *)
        rStateTimerAccumulator := rStateTimerAccumulator + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
        IF bStationGateClosedInterlock AND (rVotedSealGap_Internal <= 30.0) THEN
            IF rStateTimerAccumulator >= 0.50 THEN
                rStateTimerAccumulator := 0.0;
                iState := 20; (* Advance to Seal Inflation *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            IF rStateTimerAccumulator > 5.0 THEN
                dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Station Gate Latch Failure *)
                bSystemTrip := TRUE;
                iState := 90;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE 20: SEAL_RAPID_INFLATION - Multi-Segment S-Curve Viscoelastic Inflation Profile *)
        rStateTimerAccumulator := rStateTimerAccumulator + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
        (* Phase 1: Rapid Gap Takeup (0.0 to 2.0 bar) *)
        IF rVotedSealPress_Internal < 2.0 THEN
            rSealPressureSetpoint := rSealPressureSetpoint + (c_rSealMaxSlewRate * c_rScanTimeSeconds);
        (* Phase 2: Controlled Seating against Pod Hull (2.0 to 5.2 bar) *)
        ELSE
            rSealPressureSetpoint := rSealPressureSetpoint + (0.45 * c_rSealMaxSlewRate * c_rScanTimeSeconds);
        END_IF;

        IF rSealPressureSetpoint > c_rSealTargetNominalPressure THEN
            rSealPressureSetpoint := c_rSealTargetNominalPressure;
        END_IF;

        (* Check Seating Completion Permissive *)
        IF (rVotedSealPress_Internal >= (c_rSealTargetNominalPressure - 0.15)) AND
           (rSealContactStressMpa >= 1.85) AND
           (rVotedSealGap_Internal <= 8.5) THEN
            rStateTimerAccumulator := 0.0;
            iState := 25; (* Advance to In-situ Leak Test *)
        ELSIF rStateTimerAccumulator > 12.0 THEN
            dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0080; (* Seal Inflation Timeout / Rupture *)
            bSystemTrip := TRUE;
            iState := 90;
        END_IF;

    25: (* STATE 25: SEAL_PRESSURE_HOLD_TEST - Isolated Leak-Back Evaluation Prior to Evacuation *)
        rStateTimerAccumulator := rStateTimerAccumulator + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
        tonSealLeakHoldTest(IN := TRUE, PT := T#2S);
        IF tonSealLeakHoldTest.Q THEN
            tonSealLeakHoldTest(IN := FALSE);
            (* Verify pressure drop rate is within allowable hermetic threshold *)
            IF ABS(rCalculatedRateOfPressChange) < 15.0 THEN
                bSealsInflatedAndLocked := TRUE;
                rStateTimerAccumulator := 0.0;
                iState := 30; (* Advance to Roughing Stage 1 *)
            ELSE
                dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0100; (* Seal Gross Inleakage Detected *)
                bSystemTrip := TRUE;
                iState := 90;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE 30: STAGE1_ROOTS_RAPID_ROUGHING - High-Volume Atmospheric Evacuation to 250 Pa *)
        rStateTimerAccumulator := rStateTimerAccumulator + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
        rEvacuationTimeElapsed := rEvacuationTimeElapsed + c_rScanTimeSeconds;

        (* Ramp Roots Blower to Maximum Speed under Frequency Inverter S-Curve *)
        IF rRootsBlowerSpeedDemand < c_rRootsMaxNominalSpeed THEN
            rRootsBlowerSpeedDemand := rRootsBlowerSpeedDemand + (600.0 * c_rScanTimeSeconds);
        ELSE
            rRootsBlowerSpeedDemand := c_rRootsMaxNominalSpeed;
        END_IF;

        (* Monitor for Crossover Pressure Boundary *)
        IF rVotedAirlockPress_Internal <= c_rRootsCrossoverPressure THEN
            rStateTimerAccumulator := 0.0;
            iState := 40; (* Advance to Foreline Crossover *)
        ELSIF rStateTimerAccumulator > 180.0 THEN
            dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0200; (* Roughing Evacuation Timeout *)
            bSystemTrip := TRUE;
            iState := 90;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE 40: CROSSOVER_FORELINE_STABILIZE - Fore-vacuum Matching & TMP Spool-Up Permissive *)
        rStateTimerAccumulator := rStateTimerAccumulator + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
        rEvacuationTimeElapsed := rEvacuationTimeElapsed + c_rScanTimeSeconds;

        (* Maintain Roots at Intermediate Speed as Foreline Backing Pump *)
        rRootsBlowerSpeedDemand := 2200.0;

        (* Spin Up Mag-Lev Turbomolecular Pump Battery *)
        IF rTurbomolecularSpeedDemand < c_rTMPRatedSpeed THEN
            rTurbomolecularSpeedDemand := rTurbomolecularSpeedDemand + (2400.0 * c_rScanTimeSeconds);
        ELSE
            rTurbomolecularSpeedDemand := c_rTMPRatedSpeed;
        END_IF;

        (* Check TMP Interstage Permissive *)
        IF (rTurbomolecularSpeedFeedback >= (c_rTMPRatedSpeed * 0.92)) AND
           (rVotedAirlockPress_Internal <= c_rForelineMaxSafePressure) THEN
            rStateTimerAccumulator := 0.0;
            iState := 50; (* Advance to Turbomolecular High Vacuum *)
        ELSIF rStateTimerAccumulator > 45.0 THEN
            dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0400; (* Turbomolecular Spool Timeout *)
            bSystemTrip := TRUE;
            iState := 90;
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE 50: STAGE2_TURBOMOLECULAR_EVAC - Molecular Pumping down to Near-Vacuum Target *)
        rStateTimerAccumulator := rStateTimerAccumulator + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
        rEvacuationTimeElapsed := rEvacuationTimeElapsed + c_rScanTimeSeconds;

        rRootsBlowerSpeedDemand := 1800.0; (* Backing Roots baseline *)
        rTurbomolecularSpeedDemand := c_rTMPRatedSpeed;

        (* Near-Vacuum Target Reached (Chamber within tolerance of Guideway Tube Pressure) *)
        IF ABS(rVotedAirlockPress_Internal - rVotedTubePress_Internal) <= c_rTargetTubePressureTol THEN
            bChamberEvacuatedToTarget := TRUE;
            rStateTimerAccumulator := 0.0;
            iState := 60; (* Advance to Acoustic Shock Wave Suppression Tuning *)
        ELSIF rStateTimerAccumulator > 90.0 THEN
            dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0800; (* High Vacuum Evacuation Timeout *)
            bSystemTrip := TRUE;
            iState := 90;
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE 60: SHOCKWAVE_SUPPRESSION_TUNING - Helmholtz Resonator Position & Pressure Balancing *)
        rStateTimerAccumulator := rStateTimerAccumulator + c_rScanTimeSeconds;

        (* Active Acoustic Baffle Pre-Positioning based on Predicted Reflection Wave *)
        rAcousticBaffleLinearStroke := (rPredictedIncidentSPL / c_rShockMaxAllowableSPL) * c_rBaffleStrokeMax;

        (* Micro-Bleed Differential Pressure Balancing to within +/- 1.5 Pa *)
        IF (rVotedAirlockPress_Internal - rVotedTubePress_Internal) > 1.5 THEN
            rEqualizationValveDemand := 8.5;
        ELSIF (rVotedAirlockPress_Internal - rVotedTubePress_Internal) < -1.5 THEN
            rEqualizationValveDemand := 0.0;
        ELSE
            rEqualizationValveDemand := 0.0;
            bAcousticShockSuppressed := TRUE;
        END_IF;

        IF bAcousticShockSuppressed AND (rStateTimerAccumulator >= 1.0) THEN
            rStateTimerAccumulator := 0.0;
            iState := 65; (* Advance to Tube Gate Opening *)
        END_IF;

    65: (* STATE 65: TUBE_GATE_VALVE_FAST_OPEN - High-Speed Vacuum Knife Gate Retraction *)
        rStateTimerAccumulator := rStateTimerAccumulator + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
        bTubeGateValveOpenDemand := TRUE;

        (* Monitor Dynamic Acoustic SPL During Gate Motion *)
        IF rAcousticShockPeakSPL > c_rShockMaxAllowableSPL THEN
            dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0001_0000; (* Acoustic Shock Transgression Advisory *)
        END_IF;

        (* Gate Valve Full Open Limit Confirmation *)
        IF NOT bTubeGateClosedInterlock THEN
            rStateTimerAccumulator := 0.0;
            iState := 70; (* Advance to Pod Transit *)
        ELSIF rStateTimerAccumulator > 6.0 THEN
            dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_1000; (* Tube Gate Valve Jammed / Stalled *)
            bSystemTrip := TRUE;
            iState := 90;
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE 70: POD_INGRESS_EGRESS_TRANSIT - High-Speed Pod Transit Corridor Active *)
        rStateTimerAccumulator := rStateTimerAccumulator + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
        bTubeGateValveOpenDemand := TRUE;

        (* Confirm Pod Clearance via Transit Telemetry or Optical Radar Interlock *)
        IF bPodTransitCompleted OR (rPodApproachVelocity > 150.0 AND rStateTimerAccumulator > 4.5) THEN
            rStateTimerAccumulator := 0.0;
            iState := 75; (* Advance to Gate Reclosure *)
        ELSIF rStateTimerAccumulator > 30.0 THEN
            dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0002_0000; (* Pod Transit Window Exceeded Alert *)
        END_IF;

    75: (* STATE 75: TUBE_GATE_VALVE_FAST_CLOSE - High-Speed Vacuum Gate Re-Sealing *)
        rStateTimerAccumulator := rStateTimerAccumulator + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
        bTubeGateValveOpenDemand := FALSE;

        IF bTubeGateClosedInterlock THEN
            rStateTimerAccumulator := 0.0;
            iState := 80; (* Advance to Controlled Repressurization *)
        ELSIF rStateTimerAccumulator > 6.0 THEN
            dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_2000; (* Tube Gate Close Failure *)
            bSystemTrip := TRUE;
            iState := 90;
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE 80: CONTROLLED_DIFFUSER_REPRESS - Acoustic-Damped Quiet Repressurization *)
        rStateTimerAccumulator := rStateTimerAccumulator + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
        rRootsBlowerSpeedDemand := 0.0;
        rTurbomolecularSpeedDemand := 0.0;

        (* S-Curve Equalization Diffuser Valve Inflow to Prevent Blast Wave *)
        IF rVotedAirlockPress_Internal < 95000.0 THEN
            rEqualizationValveDemand := 45.0;
        ELSE
            rEqualizationValveDemand := 100.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Atmospheric Equilibrium Reached (101,325 Pa) *)
        IF rVotedAirlockPress_Internal >= (c_rAtmosphericBaseline - 500.0) THEN
            rEqualizationValveDemand := 0.0;
            rStateTimerAccumulator := 0.0;
            iState := 85; (* Advance to Seal Deflation *)
        END_IF;

    85: (* STATE 85: SEAL_VACUUM_DEFLATION - Active Evacuation of Seal Bladder & Retract Verification *)
        rStateTimerAccumulator := rStateTimerAccumulator + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
        rSealPressureSetpoint := 0.0;
